menu.title: House Climate
menu.description: Configure rooms for one shared heating/cooling system. Changes take effect only when you save.

room.title: Room settings

data.name: Room name
data.head: Heat-pump head
data.report_on_change_sensors: Sensors that report only on change

remove_room.title: Remove room
remove_room.description:
Remove airflow links and the auxiliary heater assignment first. At least one room must remain.

{detail}

schedule.title: Daily comfort schedule
schedule.description:
Uses Home Assistant's timezone. A schedule may cross midnight; schedules in the same room must not overlap. The base profile applies outside these hours. Fan speed applies to fans using the schedule strategy.

{detail}

fan.title: Fan behavior
fan.description:
Assign fans to the room they help, even if physically located elsewhere. For airflow transfer, select the room supplying useful air. Scheduled fans use the active room profile's speed.

{detail}

system.title: System settings

data.equipment_timing_confirmed: I have verified the equipment timing

data_description.head_activation_timeout_seconds: Seconds to wait for an exact heat-pump mode and setpoint report. Off commands and safety checks keep their normal timing.

auxiliary.title: Optional auxiliary heater
auxiliary.description:
Room probes control this heater externally. Choose a high device setpoint that reliably calls for heat, and a separate cutoff above the room's comfort band. Exclude the heater's own sensor and separate fan entity from room configuration. The native watchdog follows these settings automatically.

{detail}

data.auxiliary_fan_enabled: Use fan-only mode during cooling demand
data.heater_setpoint_confirmed: I have verified the device setpoint

import_file.title: Import existing configuration
import_file.description:
Enter a TOML path relative to the Home Assistant configuration directory. Import replaces this draft and starts in shadow mode. Version-1 helper values are copied from HA when available.

{detail}

finish.title: Review and save
finish.description:
{detail}

Saving applies all edits and reloads the controller. Owned devices are stopped, and the Controller enabled switch starts off. Turn it on from the device page when ready for live control.

head_limits.title: Choose a heat-pump head
head_limits.description:
Choose the head whose lowest cooling setpoint you want to configure. Rooms sharing a head share this setting.

{detail}

head_limit.title: Cooling setpoint limit
head_limit.description:
{detail}

Enable this only when you know the lowest cooling setpoint your equipment accepts. Active cooling calls stay at or above this temperature even if Home Assistant reports a lower device minimum. Room comfort targets stay unchanged. Leave it disabled to use the device's reported range. Applying to all updates every configured heat-pump head in this draft.

data.apply_to_all: Apply this setting to all heat-pump heads

error.invalid_config: The configuration could not be saved. Review the details above.
error.room_in_use: This room is still referenced, or is the last remaining room.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only one shared-system controller may be configured.
